roadmap.title: Base campaign and core abilities
roadmap.description: Complete all ten story missions, collect nearby files, cleanse every Control Point, and obtain Launch, Shield, Evade, Seize, and Levitate as their missions become available.

roadmap.title: Base-game side missions and progression cleanup
roadmap.description: Complete at least 15 side missions, defeat the five optional bosses, work through Alerts and Board Countermeasures, and finish the collectible, Source, Control Point, ability, and combat totals.

roadmap.title: The Foundation
roadmap.description: After the campaign, complete every Foundation mission while collecting all 57 files, all ten hidden locations, and all eight Maneki-neko; finish the Foundation combat counters during cleanup.

roadmap.title: AWE Investigations Sector
roadmap.description: Complete the AWE story and side content, test vending machines early, find at least 54 collectibles and four hidden locations, then finish Surge, Multi-Launch, and airborne-enemy counters.

achievements.summary: Take the @item{Service Weapon} from the Director's Office and finish its Astral Plane trial.

guide.context: This occurs during the opening mission after Jesse meets Ahti and reaches the Executive Sector.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Director's Office}, pick up the @item{Service Weapon} from the floor, and complete the shooting and platforming tutorial in the Astral Plane.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Self-Reflection} in the Synchronicity Lab and defeat esseJ inside the mirror.

guide.context: Clearance Level 6 is required. In the real lab, white panels open shutters and black panels close them; copy the opposite arrangement visible through the mirror.

steps.text: After Mission 7, collect @item{Mirror Supplement} in the @loc{Synchronicity Lab} to start Self-Reflection.
Set the three real-world shutter panels to mirror the opposite states shown through the glass, then enter the opened mirror chamber.
Go upstairs and inspect the mannequin cells three times, defeat @enemy{esseJ}, and return through the mirror to complete the mission.

achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Old Growth} by gaining mold immunity and defeating Mold-1 beneath Central Research.

guide.context: Dr. Underhill's laboratory is reached through the Active Threshold basement below Central Research.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Dr. Underhill}, collect the requested mold samples, and return them to receive mold immunity.
Continue @loc{Old Growth} into the Mold Threshold and destroy @enemy{Mold-1} to complete the mission.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mr. Tommasi} and defeat Alberto Tommasi in the Sterling AWE area.

guide.context: Emily Pope offers this side mission in the Executive Board Room after Mission 7.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Emily Pope} in the @loc{Executive Board Room} and accept Mr. Tommasi.
Travel to @loc{Containment > Sterling AWE}, use cover against Tommasi's projectiles, clear reinforcing Hiss, and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Destroy @enemy{Anchor} in @loc{Sealed Threshold} after completing A Matter of Time.

guide.context: The Enemy Within starts automatically after A Matter of Time, which begins with the wounded Horowitz in Logistics.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Horowitz} in Logistics and finish @loc{A Matter of Time} to unlock The Enemy Within.
Follow The Enemy Within into the @loc{Sealed Threshold}, attack the Anchor when its vulnerable face opens, and defeat it.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Fridge Duty} by entering the altered refrigerator and defeating Former.

guide.context: Phillip is trapped beside a fourth-floor Panopticon cell near the upper Control Point.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Phillip} beside the altered refrigerator on the Panopticon's fourth floor and accept Fridge Duty.
Enter the refrigerator encounter, destroy @enemy{Former}'s eye while avoiding its limbs and floor holes, and finish the mission.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 1: Welcome to the Oldest House} after Jesse becomes Director.

guide.context: The mission is mandatory and can be completed with any Assist Mode settings.

steps.text: Follow every objective in @loc{Welcome to the Oldest House} until the mission-complete notification awards the achievement.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 2: Unknown Caller} after cleansing the Hotline.

guide.context: This is the second mandatory story mission and also introduces the Launch ability.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Hotline Chamber}, cleanse the Hotline Object of Power, and finish the remaining objectives in @loc{Unknown Caller}.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 3: Directorial Override} by lifting the Oldest House lockdown.

guide.context: The lockdown is lifted from the NSC control room at the end of this mandatory mission.

steps.text: Finish every objective in @loc{Directorial Override} and use the central control panel in the NSC control room to lift the lockdown.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 4: Old Boys' Club} after helping Marshall's research team.

guide.context: This mandatory mission opens more of the Research Sector and enables the Seize side mission afterward.

steps.text: Complete every marked objective in @loc{Old Boys' Club} until its mission-complete notification appears.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 5: Threshold} after securing the Black Rock Quarry route.

guide.context: Threshold is a mandatory Maintenance Sector story mission.

steps.text: Follow every objective in @loc{Threshold} until the mission-complete notification awards the achievement.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 6: My Brother's Keeper} after reaching Dylan in the Panopticon.

guide.context: The Salvador encounter during this mission also grants Levitate.

steps.text: Advance through the @loc{Panopticon}, defeat Salvador, reach Dylan's cell, and finish @loc{My Brother's Keeper}.

achievements.summary: Complete the seventh campaign mission after investigating @loc{Ordinary AWE} and finding the Ordinary Dump slide projector.

guide.context: Finishing this mandatory mission opens the late-game side missions and the Investigations Sector elevator destination.

steps.text: Complete every objective in @loc{The Face of the Enemy} until the mission-complete notification appears.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 8: Finnish Tango} and follow Ahti's route through the Ashtray Maze.

guide.context: This mandatory mission prepares the path to the campaign finale.

steps.text: Follow Ahti's clues, traverse the @loc{Ashtray Maze}, and complete all remaining objectives in @loc{Finnish Tango}.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 9: Polaris} after reaching the Hedron Chamber.

guide.context: Polaris is the penultimate mandatory story mission.

steps.text: Fight through the Nostalgia Department and Hedron Chamber, then finish every objective in @loc{Polaris}.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Mission 10: Take Control} and finish the base campaign.

guide.context: Free exploration remains available after the credits, and Foundation begins from the Hotline Chamber afterward.

steps.text: Complete the office sequence and final combat objectives in @loc{Take Control} until the campaign-ending scene awards the achievement.

achievements.summary: Cleanse the @item{Floppy Disk} during Mission 2 and complete its Astral Plane trial to obtain Launch.

guide.context: Launch is mandatory story progress and becomes Jesse's most versatile combat and puzzle ability.

steps.text: Follow @loc{Unknown Caller} to the Floppy Disk Object of Power, cleanse it, and use Launch to complete the Astral Plane tutorial.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{A Good Defense} and cleanse the Safe Object of Power to obtain Shield.

guide.context: The mission starts from the Home Safe Tests file in the Black Rock Processing lab at Central Maintenance.

steps.text: Collect @item{Home Safe Tests} from the lab south of the Central Maintenance entrance and follow the mission to @loc{Field Training}.
Complete the timed Field Training course, enter the Astral Plane, and cleanse the @item{Safe} to unlock Shield.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{A Merry Chase} from the Maintenance break room to obtain Evade.

guide.context: The break room is near Ahti's Janitor's Office and becomes accessible early in Maintenance.

steps.text: Enter the altered break room near the @loc{Janitor's Office} and follow the traffic-light Object of Power into the Astral Plane.
Use the newly taught dash to finish the Astral Plane course and cleanse the Object of Power, permanently unlocking @mechanic{Evade}.

achievements.summary: Complete @loc{A Captive Audience} in the Hypnosis Lab to obtain Seize.

guide.context: The mission becomes available after Jesse meets Marshall. Its hypnosis puzzle uses the fixed sequence 1-7-7-1-6-4-9-7.

steps.text: Start @loc{A Captive Audience} in the Research Sector's Hypnosis Lab and enter @mechanic{1-7-7-1-6-4-9-7} on the control panels to open the chamber.
Enter the Astral Plane and cleanse the @item{X-Ray Lightbox} to permanently unlock Seize.

achievements.summary: Defeat Salvador during Mission 6 and complete the Astral Plane trial to obtain Levitate.

guide.context: Levitate is mandatory and is needed to reach many hidden locations and late collectibles.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Salvador} in the Panopticon, then use Levitate to finish the resulting Astral Plane tutorial.

achievements.description: Find all hidden locations in the Foundation
achievements.summary: Discover all ten hidden locations in @loc{The Foundation}.

guide.context: A hidden-location notification and one Ability Point confirm each discovery; several rooms also contain a required Foundation collectible.

steps.text: From @loc{Crossroads}, drop to the western cliff ledge behind the Nail, turn toward the cliff, break the boards, and enter the dark cave.
From @loc{Astral Collision}, glide from the yellow-rope post to the distant gold-block platform and then into the toilet cubicle fused to the next platform.
At @loc{Astral Tower PE}, levitate to the highest pillar and interact with the television at the summit.
From @loc{Cave Bridge}, cross to the far bridge and enter the unblocked cave opposite the Crossroads-sign passage.
From @loc{Warehouse Rise}, follow the uphill cave to a floodlight and levitate down into the lower doorway in the Warehouse shaft.
Ride to @loc{Floor 6: Upper Warehouse}, go behind the elevator, and break the wall beneath the framed photograph.
In @loc{Data Entry and Filing}, enter the lit ground-floor corner office on the right and break the painting wall.
On the fourth floor of @loc{Data Entry and Filing}, break the painting wall in the office opposite the previous hidden room.
From @loc{Transit Access}, enter Transit Control, call the cargo lift, step off immediately, and drop into the exposed lift pit.
Climb from Evaluation Hall into @loc{Sector Lobby C}, open the noisy elevator, kill the Mold Host, and step inside.

achievements.summary: Collect all eight @item{Maneki-neko} in Foundation and claim the cat ears from the Firebreak reward room.

guide.context: The cats appear together in a Firebreak display. After all eight are present, the adjacent secret room opens and holds the wearable reward.

steps.text: In the @loc{Chasm}, carry a light deep past the Found Footage route, clear the rocks concealing a side cave, and collect the cat beside Talented Janitor.
Near @loc{Cave Bridge}, gather all eight black cubes without leaving the area and place one on every paw-print square in the floor grid.
At @loc{Astral Tower PW}, break the crystals covering a gold cube, carry it upstairs to the gold socket, and land on the nearby floating pillar.
In the ground-floor Data Entry office, break the painting wall, then break the poster wall inside the hidden room.
Throw the Astral Collision gold cube into the toilet cubicle, later recover it from the fifth-floor Collapsed Department restroom, and place it in the gold socket there.
From the Firebreak cave overlooking Crossroads, levitate across three left-side ledges and open the cardboard box on the last ledge.
Ride the Warehouse elevator from Floor 5 to Floor 6 and melee all four exterior Hiss nodes during that single ascent; collect the spawned cat on Floor 6.
On Warehouse Floor 0, turn the valve opposite the large door, return outside, and activate the shower in the middle of the three western mobile labs.
Visit the @loc{Firebreak} cat display after collecting all eight and enter the newly opened room to collect the cat ears.

achievements.description: Complete the Side Mission "Jesse Faden starring in 'Swift Platform'"
achievements.summary: Complete the Foundation side mission @loc{Jesse Faden Starring in Swift Platform}.

guide.context: The mission begins from a side passage near Transit Access in Collapsed Department after that route is open.

steps.text: At @loc{Transit Access}, enter the side department containing the altered film camera to start Jesse Faden Starring in Swift Platform.
Stay aboard the moving platform, destroy obstacles and enemies during the sequence, and defeat the final wave to complete the mission.

achievements.summary: Enter the Astral Plane restroom on the fifth floor of Collapsed Department.

guide.context: The restroom is in the corridor between Data Entry and Filing and the Firebreak door.

steps.text: Reach the fifth-floor Firebreak corridor in @loc{Collapsed Department}, open the restroom on the right, and step into its floating Astral Plane interior.

achievements.summary: Survive the first Hartman encounter in @loc{Active Investigations} and force him to retreat.

guide.context: Hartman is vulnerable only in bright areas; restoring power and staying near lit platforms controls the encounter.

steps.text: Follow the AWE mission objectives to restore power and activate the lights in @loc{Active Investigations}.
Damage @enemy{Hartman} while the area is lit and survive until he withdraws, completing the mandatory encounter.

achievements.description: Find 80% of the hidden locations in the Investigations Sector
achievements.summary: Discover any four of the five hidden locations in the AWE Investigations Sector.

guide.context: Each discovery awards one Ability Point; the Shifted Passage clock room is optional because only 80% is required.

steps.text: In western @loc{Abandoned Offices}, enter the office beside the immovable cabinets and break the wall beneath the framed damage photograph.
From @loc{Fra Mauro AWE Entrance}, reach Observation Deck and drop into the dark elevator shaft immediately left of the powered lift.
From @loc{Eagle Limited AWE Entrance}, drop to the turntable's lower floor, turn around, and break the painting wall below the Control Point doorway.
From @loc{Lower Access}, enter Shifted Offices, climb the first short stairs, turn around, and levitate to the ledge overhead.
In Shifted Passage, drop east from the Astral Spike, break the painting wall, climb into the sideways office, and break the later blank wall to reach the clock room.

achievements.description: Destroy 80% of the Altered Vending Machine instances
achievements.summary: Destroy four red, hostile @enemy{Altered Vending Machines} in AWE before they escape.

guide.context: Ordinary vending machines are harmless; an altered instance turns red and attacks when shot. Spawns are random and can stop appearing on a bugged save.

steps.text: Fast travel to @loc{Active Investigations}, backtrack through Operations Center, and shoot the three vending machines on the second floor.
If a machine turns red and attacks, use Surge or strong Service Weapon fire to destroy it before it vanishes.
Return to the main menu, continue the game to respawn vending machines, and repeat the route until four altered instances have been destroyed.
If many full reload loops produce no altered spawns, finish other checks before using Mission Select's Endgame reset, because that reset removes later DLC progress.

achievements.summary: Complete AWE's final Bright Falls encounter and defeat Hartman.

guide.context: Hartman drains power during the fight; darkness protects him, so restoring each disabled light is the priority.

steps.text: During the final @loc{Bright Falls AWE} fight, carry power cores back to any generators Hartman disables and reactivate the arena lights.
Attack @enemy{Hartman} only while he is exposed in the light, repeat the power-restoration cycle, and deplete his health.

achievements.description: Play a single game in Arcade Mode
achievements.summary: Use the Shüm cabinet in Active Investigations and complete one Arcade Mode game.

guide.context: The cabinet becomes usable after the first Hartman encounter; only one listed game must be cleared.

steps.text: Return to @loc{Active Investigations}, interact with the @item{Shüm arcade cabinet}, select an available challenge, and finish its win condition.

achievements.description: Construct a Weapon Form or Mod
achievements.summary: Construct one Weapon Form or Mod through @mechanic{Astral Constructs} at a cleansed Control Point.

guide.context: Construction spends Source and materials; opening crates and defeating enemies supplies both.

steps.text: Use any cleansed Control Point, open @mechanic{Astral Constructs}, select Weapon Forms or Mods, and purchase one available construction.

achievements.description: Upgrade any Weapon Form to Level 3
achievements.summary: Purchase both upgrades for one Service Weapon Form to raise it to Level 3.

guide.context: Higher upgrade tiers appear as the campaign advances and require Source plus specific materials.

steps.text: At a Control Point, open @mechanic{Astral Constructs > Weapon Forms} and buy the Level 2 and Level 3 upgrades for the same weapon form.

achievements.summary: Spend 30 Ability Points to unlock all three Personal Mod slots.

guide.context: The second slot opens at 15 spent points and the third at 30; mission rewards and hidden locations provide the points.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Abilities} at Control Points and spend 30 total Ability Points across Jesse's upgrade branches.

achievements.summary: Complete any five base-game side missions.

guide.context: Ability missions, altered-item missions, boss missions, and Ahti's What a Mess tasks all contribute.

steps.text: Finish five missions listed under @mechanic{Missions > Side Missions} and allow each mission-complete notification to appear.

achievements.summary: Complete any ten base-game side missions.

guide.context: There are 18 eligible side missions, so no specific set of ten is required.

steps.text: Finish ten entries from @mechanic{Missions > Side Missions}, including ability or What a Mess tasks if convenient.

achievements.summary: Complete any 15 of the 18 base-game side missions.

guide.context: The three ability missions count, and Ahti's six What a Mess jobs provide a quick block of eligible completions.

steps.text: Finish 15 distinct base-game side missions and check the Missions menu after every completion until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Earn more than 100,000 @item{Source} cumulatively across the save.

guide.context: Cumulative Source earnings remain recorded after Source is spent on Mods, Weapon Forms, and upgrades.

steps.text: Complete missions, open containers, dismantle unwanted Mods, and defeat respawning Hiss until cumulative Source earnings exceed 100,000.

achievements.summary: Kill 1,000 @enemy{Hiss} cumulatively across the campaign, side missions, Alerts, and expansions.

guide.context: All eligible kills share one save-wide counter, making deliberate farming unnecessary until every other combat task is finished.

steps.text: Complete the campaign, side missions, Bureau Alerts, Board Countermeasures, Foundation, and AWE while killing encountered Hiss.
If the achievement remains locked, revisit enemy-heavy sectors through Control Points and clear respawning encounters until the total reaches 1,000.

achievements.summary: Spend one Ability Point on any upgrade at a Control Point.

guide.context: Mission completion awards the first available Ability Points early in the story.

steps.text: Use a cleansed Control Point, open @mechanic{Abilities}, and purchase any available upgrade.

achievements.summary: Spend 50 Ability Points across Jesse's upgrade branches.

guide.context: Main missions, side missions, and discovered hidden locations all award Ability Points.

steps.text: Continue completing missions and finding hidden locations, then spend 50 total points through @mechanic{Abilities} at Control Points.

achievements.summary: Spend 100 Ability Points across Jesse's upgrade branches.

guide.context: Ultimate Edition has more upgrades than the original release, so the unlock checks points spent rather than a fully filled visible tree.

steps.text: Complete all base and expansion missions and visit hidden locations to earn a large Ability Point pool.
Spend 100 cumulative points through @mechanic{Abilities} at Control Points.

achievements.summary: Cleanse five Control Points in the base-game sectors.

guide.context: Control Points become usable after nearby Hiss are cleared and then serve as fast-travel and upgrade stations.

steps.text: Clear enemies around five corrupted Control Points and hold the cleanse prompt at each one.

achievements.summary: Cleanse ten Control Points in the base-game sectors.

guide.context: Story progression naturally passes more than ten eligible Control Points.

steps.text: Clear and cleanse ten distinct base-game Control Points.

achievements.summary: Cleanse 25 of the 29 base-game Control Points.

guide.context: Foundation and AWE Control Points are not required; side missions open enough optional base-game areas to reach 25.

steps.text: Finish the campaign and side missions to unlock Executive, Maintenance, Research, and Containment routes.
Clear the Hiss and cleanse Control Points in those four sectors until the base-game total reaches 25.

achievements.summary: Collect 40 documents, recordings, case files, correspondence items, or Hotline entries.

guide.context: Many collectibles are awarded automatically by missions and remain saved after death.

steps.text: Pick up white-dot files while exploring and complete story objectives until the Collectibles menu reaches 40 entries.

achievements.summary: Collect 80 documents, recordings, case files, correspondence items, or Hotline entries.

guide.context: The game contains far more than 80 eligible items, so ordinary exploration is sufficient.

steps.text: Search offices, labs, shelters, and mission rooms for white-dot files until the Collectibles menu reaches 80 entries.

achievements.summary: Collect 120 base-game documents, recordings, case files, correspondence items, or Hotline entries.

guide.context: More than 250 base-game collectibles exist. Clearance Level 6 and Levitate make late cleanup easier, and collected files persist after death.

steps.text: Complete the campaign and side missions to receive automatic entries and open every clearance-locked area.
Explore offices, labs, shelters, and hidden rooms, approaching each white-dot pickup until the Collectibles menu reaches 120.

achievements.description: Compel 10 enemies with the Seize Ability
achievements.summary: Use Seize to convert ten weakened enemies into temporary allies.

guide.context: A converted enemy may die afterward without removing credit; each completed conversion counts once.

steps.text: Reduce an enemy to low health, hold the @mechanic{Seize} prompt until conversion finishes, and complete ten conversions.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with the Launch Ability
achievements.summary: Use Launch to deal the killing blow to 50 enemies.

guide.context: Launch damage upgrades make this counter progress naturally during the campaign.

steps.text: Grab debris with @mechanic{Launch} and throw it for the killing blow on 50 enemies.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with the Shield Burst Ability
achievements.summary: Kill ten weakened enemies by releasing Shield after buying the Shield Barrage upgrade.

guide.context: The achievement description calls the attack Shield Burst, but the upgrade's menu name is Shield Barrage.

steps.text: Obtain Shield and purchase @mechanic{Shield Barrage} in the Shield ability branch.
Weaken an enemy, hold Shield while standing close, and release it so the projected debris lands the killing blow; repeat for ten kills.

achievements.description: Use Launch to throw a grenade or rocket
achievements.summary: Catch a live grenade or rocket with Launch and throw the explosive back.

guide.context: The Launch Explosives upgrade is required before hostile projectiles can be caught.

steps.text: Purchase @mechanic{Launch Explosives} in the Launch ability branch.
When a Hiss throws a grenade or fires a rocket, hold Launch to catch it, aim at an enemy, and release before it detonates.

achievements.summary: Complete and claim rewards for five Board Countermeasures.

guide.context: Up to three Countermeasures can be active. Abandoning an awkward one has no penalty and immediately reveals a replacement.

steps.text: At a Control Point, open @mechanic{Board Countermeasures} and accept simple tasks matching available sectors and common enemies.
Meet each listed weapon, enemy, and location condition, then return to the menu and claim five completed rewards.

achievements.summary: Complete and claim rewards for 25 Board Countermeasures.

guide.context: Only claimed Countermeasures count, so completed tasks must be collected from the Control Point menu.

steps.text: Keep three easy Countermeasures active, abandon rare-enemy or inconvenient weapon conditions, and replace them immediately.
Fulfill and claim 25 Board Countermeasure rewards across the campaign and cleanup.

achievements.summary: Finish one timed Bureau Alert before its 20-minute limit expires.

guide.context: Alerts appear randomly during play and fail if Jesse dies before the objective is complete.

steps.text: Accept an active Bureau Alert, fast travel to its named sector, and finish the enemy, Hiss Node, or protection objective within 20 minutes without dying.

achievements.summary: Finish five timed Bureau Alerts before their 20-minute limits expire.

guide.context: Alerts continue appearing after the story, so failed or ignored events do not permanently block the achievement.

steps.text: Whenever a Bureau Alert appears, travel to its marked sector and complete its combat or protection objective without dying; finish five alerts total.

achievements.description: Use Shape and Fracture a combined total of 100 times
achievements.summary: Use Foundation's Shape and Fracture powers a combined 100 times.

guide.context: Both traversal crystals and combat uses contribute, so repeated actions during the Foundation route reduce cleanup.

steps.text: Create crystal ledges with @mechanic{Shape} and destroy crystal growths with @mechanic{Fracture} during exploration and combat until the combined counter reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Kill 50 @enemy{Hiss Sharpened} in Foundation.

guide.context: Sharpened are the fast melee Hiss introduced by the expansion and respawn in Foundation combat areas.

steps.text: Prioritize Hiss Sharpened throughout Foundation missions, then revisit combat-heavy Control Points and defeat respawning groups until 50 kills register.

achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies by striking them with the Shield Rush ability.

guide.context: Only killing impacts count; weakening targets first prevents ordinary gunfire or Launch from taking the final blow.

steps.text: Purchase @mechanic{Shield Rush} from the Shield ability branch.
Weaken an enemy, raise Shield, sprint or Evade directly into the target, and ensure the collision kills it; repeat for 100 enemies.

achievements.description: Collect all Collectibles in the Foundation
achievements.summary: Collect all 57 files and automatic entries in @loc{The Foundation}.

guide.context: Finish every Foundation main and side mission first because story, enemy, and side-mission records count toward the 57. Hidden rooms contain several manual files.

steps.text: Sweep Research Site Gamma for Log 1: Discovery, Adventure Accepted, and Log 4: ID; sweep the Chasm for VHS Tape Supplement and Talented Janitor.

Sweep Cave System for Cave Paintings, Relocation Order, and Foundation Accident; sweep Crossroads for Leylines, Foundation Pillar, Log 2: Foundation, Unacceptable Behavior Memo, Log 7: Changes, and Log 8: Purpose.
Collect FBC Reminder: Windows, Maneki-Neko Procedures, Were-Everything, Green, Log 6: Departure, Rejected Episode, and America Overnight Fatality across Astral Collision and its towers.

Collect Shift Account parts 1–3, Kyiv Summary, Kyiv Supplement, America Overnight episodes 367 and 382, Computer Program, New Language, Brian's Movie Den Ep. 3, and Movie Camera Supplement in Collapsed Department.

Collect History of the Oldest House, Pyramidic Geometry, Log 3: Work, Power Cores, Meteor Hill Summary, Log 5: Pyramids, Meteor Hill Supplement, Foundation Etchings, Northmoor: Medical Results, Ash: Request Denied, and Northmoor: Final Warning in Warehouse.
Complete all Foundation story and side missions and defeat at least one Hiss Sharpened, Astral Copy, and Astral Mimic to receive the automatic Hotline, case-file, and enemy-research entries.
Check the Foundation entries in the Collectibles menu and revisit named areas for any missing title until all 57 are registered.

If all 57 Foundation entries are registered but the achievement remains locked, complete @loc{Jesse Faden Starring in Swift Platform}, collect another remaining item, and revisit a Control Point before considering Mission Select.

achievements.description: Have a Deployed Ranger kill 5 enemies
achievements.summary: Let a deployed Foundation Ranger land five cumulative enemy killing blows.

guide.context: Ranger terminals are marked on the Foundation map. Jesse may weaken targets, but the Ranger must deliver each final hit.

steps.text: Use a marked @item{Ranger terminal} in Foundation to summon an allied Ranger.
Bring nearby enemies to low health, stop attacking, and keep the Ranger alive while it finishes five enemies.

achievements.description: Complete all Missions in the Foundation
achievements.summary: Complete all three main missions and all three side missions in @loc{The Foundation}.

guide.context: The required side missions are Pope's Collection, Found Footage, and Jesse Faden Starring in Swift Platform.

steps.text: Complete @loc{The Foundation}, @loc{The Nail}, and @loc{The Pyramid}.
Complete @loc{Pope's Collection}, @loc{Found Footage}, and @loc{Jesse Faden Starring in Swift Platform}.

achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with the AWE Surge Weapon Form.

guide.context: Surge fires sticky grenades that may be detonated manually, making groups of weakened enemies efficient targets.

steps.text: Equip @item{Surge}, attach grenades to enemies or nearby surfaces, and detonate them for 50 killing blows.

achievements.summary: Kill 25 hovering @enemy{Airborne Rangers} in AWE.

guide.context: Airborne Rangers appear repeatedly in Investigations Sector missions and combat replays.

steps.text: Prioritize hovering Rangers during AWE encounters and finish 25 with Service Weapon fire, Launch, or Surge.

achievements.summary: Use Multi-Launch once to hit three different enemies in the same release.

guide.context: Multi-Launch is the final upgrade in the Launch branch and can hold three loose objects simultaneously.

steps.text: Purchase @mechanic{Multi-Launch} at the end of the Launch ability branch.
During a group fight, hold Launch to gather three objects, move the aim until three enemies are marked, and release all objects together.

achievements.description: Find 80% of the Collectibles in the Investigations Sector
achievements.summary: Register at least 54 of AWE's 67 Investigations Sector collectibles.

guide.context: Automatic Hotline and enemy records count toward the 80% threshold, so completing every AWE mission before cleanup substantially reduces manual searching.

steps.text: Complete every AWE main and side mission and defeat each new enemy type at least once to receive automatic entries.
Collect every visible file and recording in Active Investigations, Abandoned Offices, Fra Mauro AWE, Operations Center, and Bright Falls AWE.
Collect every visible file and recording in AWE Transit Bay, Eagle Limited AWE, Shifted Offices, and Shifted Passage, including documents in breakable-wall rooms and beneath lifts.
Use the Collectibles category counters to continue area cleanup until at least 54 Investigations Sector entries are registered.

achievements.description: Attach a Surge grenade to an object and Launch it at an enemy
achievements.summary: Attach a Surge grenade to loose debris, Launch the armed debris at a @enemy{Hiss}, and damage that Hiss with the explosion.

guide.context: The grenade must remain attached to the launched object; firing Surge directly at the enemy does not satisfy the combined technique.

steps.text: Equip @item{Surge} and fire one undetonated grenade onto a loose object that Launch can grab.
Use Launch on the grenade-bearing object, aim at an enemy, and release it so the attached grenade explodes against the target.

achievements.description: Upgrade Surge to the maximum level
achievements.summary: Purchase both upgrades for the AWE Surge Weapon Form to raise it to Level 3.

guide.context: The upgrade tiers require AWE materials and story progress, so collect drops and containers throughout Investigations.

steps.text: At a Control Point, open @mechanic{Astral Constructs > Weapon Forms} and buy Surge's Level 2 and Level 3 upgrades.
